title: Kardelen
author: Aşkım Kapışmak
description: When twenty-five-year-old Kardelen is found brutally murdered in a rented flat in Cihangir, Chief Inspector Rıfat Tezcan is confronted with a meticulously staged crime scene and a mysterious copper necklace bearing nine symbols of Diyarbakır. As the investigation leads from Istanbul’s marginalised streets to an influential family in the southeast, the case begins to echo a tragedy buried deep in Rıfat’s own past, threatening both his judgement and his grip on reality. Alternating between the murder investigation in 2024 and Kardelen’s childhood, the novel gradually reveals the life behind the victim: orphaned at an early age, raised as an invisible servant in a wealthy household and subjected to years of abuse, she finds refuge in books and the courage to imagine escape. Combining a psychologically layered police procedural with a powerful story of survival, Kardelen explores violence against women, childhood trauma, inherited guilt and the devastating consequences of collective silence.
